summary: Fifth Third Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing the September 22, 2026 expiration and results of its offer to exchange any and all outstanding restricted senior notes issued under a Securities Act exemption for an equal principal amount of new SEC-registered notes. The press release, dated September 23, 2026, reports the exchange results; no price per share, premium, or aggregate value is stated. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a registration-rights-type exchange offer, not a cash tender. Watch for settlement mechanics, participation level, and any remaining unregistered notes overhang.
